design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (Ellison household, Indiana; root = named driver exclusion credit signed by the named insured). Revised in rework round 2 against audits/policy_task/policy_endorsements_and_renewals/{_difficulty,1}.md.

0. Revision record (round 4, against the revision_3 sections of audits/policy_task/policy_endorsements_and_renewals/{_difficulty,1}.md).
- R3-F1 (member_report_window: the lapse-marker condition on a reporting deadline is not weighed by the line): the factor and its overwrite of the auto_driver_changes window sentence are withdrawn; the charge-start ladder tests the package's own household_driver_report_days, as the base states. R2-O2 / r1 finding 6 is now closed by changing the row, not the policy: Tyler's addition is recorded 2026-09-11, day 28 of Standard's 30 days, so the licence-date effective date is what auto_driver_changes prescribes (persona: reported about four weeks after licensing, around September 11). The 9-20 fender bender and 9-23 fault finding now follow his addition.
- To keep the drawn five factors on the driver addition premium, the two-source loyalty factor is split into its two business conditions: tenure_loyalty_credit (tenure only) and continuous_coverage_share (parameter, the lapse marker: none -> whole credit; lapse 36+ months before booking -> half; more recent lapse -> none). Gold figures unchanged (346.44 / 74.99); every factor bears weight; the all-standard addition figure is now 361.10.

0''. Revision record (round 3, against the revision_2 sections of audits/policy_task/policy_endorsements_and_renewals/{_difficulty,1}.md).
- R2-F1 (driver_minimum_charge_period billed 120 days with 81 left, past the 2026-12-15 expiration): the factor is withdrawn; charged days never exceed the days left in the term. Its place is taken by member_report_window (parameter): the package's household driver report days, +15 for a member who became licensed and +7 for one who moved in, on a policy record without a lapse marker; +0 otherwise. The base window sentence of auto_driver_changes is declared overwritten.
- r1 finding 6 / R2-O2 (Tyler's addition keyed with his licence date though reported on day 42; the round-2 claim that it was closed was not borne out): the seed row is now consistent with the rule set: Tyler's window is 45 days, so the licence-date effective date is what the (overwritten) window prescribes; the charge-start ladder is window-first (inside -> effective date; otherwise -> recorded date, the standard).
- R2-O6: an addition that took effect before the current term charges nothing (charged days start at the term expiration date).
- R2-O3 (exclusion credit denominator not the AP's day basis): the credit divides the written charge by the days that charge was written for (here 123 on both sides, from 2026-08-14). The customer now nets 346.44 - 74.99 = 271.45 for Tyler; the gap to a plain pro rata is the retention and loss shares (R2-O5, kept as stated by the audit).
- R2-P1 (charter): the exclusion sentence is scoped to a driver 'added during the current term with a premium effect'; drivers scheduled at issue (Laura, Greg) are no longer blocked and fall to the full-term-charge tier.
- Re-run: addition premium 337.99 -> 346.44, exclusion credit 73.16 -> 74.99; every factor bears weight; gates re-run.

0'. Revision record (round 2).
- Finding 1 / G4a (exclusion_credit_rate: tenure + returned-payment haircut on an endorsement credit): removed; the billing reads it needed are gone from GT and the seed.
- Finding 2 (persona said the representative may take care of side work "first"; no_user_hint false): the background authorisation is deleted; the only remaining line is a passive reaction conditional on the representative raising other work, with no ordering word. no_user_hint rewritten to match.
- G2d / finding 3 (Teen Coach discount granted and recaptured midterm against the telematics charter): both factors and the enrollment row removed.
- O6 / finding 5 (edge was an existence switch): the credit base now carries the amount written on the AP entry (unearned share of what was actually charged), so the edge carries a value.
- Base consistency found while revising: the policy was on Plus, whose accident forgiveness (36 months; tenure 57) would forgive Tyler's first chargeable accident under base rating, contradicting the loss load. The package is now Cardinal Auto Standard (no forgiveness, 30 percent at-fault surcharge, 30 household report days, exclusions allowed).
- New auto-owned factors: operator_assignment and driver_minimum_charge_period on the addition premium; exclusion_credit_basis (method) on the credit.

1. Why this is a good test. Laura asks only to finish excluding Tyler (form awaiting signature, dated 2026-10-03). The exclusion rule says "Where the excluded driver was added during the current term with a premium effect, the exclusion credit is not worked out until that driver's addition carries its own additional premium entry on the policy." Tyler's addition (effective 2026-08-14, recorded 2026-09-11, 1,512.40 -> 2,208.00) has none: nothing has been charged for him, so nothing could be credited. The agent books the addition premium (five factors) and then works out the credit on what was charged (four factors).

2. Scope. Draw: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4, 5]. Claimed: auto_ext_named_driver_exclusion_credit (4, owner=user sign_named_driver_exclusion_c094ed6f) and auto_ext_driver_addition_premium (5, book_driver_addition_premium_cd2c8cbf). Task 0 holds the vehicle addition premium, the vehicle removal credit and the cancellation refund; scopes disjoint; all five policies covered.

3. Problem-tree card. Edge: value_input, gate ex_written, state form, negated "not ... until". False at opening: initial_state.auto_transactions.f80b0e5d....premium_effect = additional and no AP has it as source. Only book_driver_addition_premium ties an AP to a driver addition. Skip run: credit 0.00 instead of 74.99. Order: addition premium (step 11) -> signature (step 13).

4. Base-invariant card. Exclusion write: policy_open_for_driver_change (status in_force); exclusion_signed declared overwritten (signature carries out the exclusion); base "takes effect on the date the form was signed or a later date the named insured chose" implemented by signature_start (form 2026-10-03 < signing 2026-10-05 -> 2026-10-05); Standard allows exclusions; no filing. Addition premium: base late-report sentence ("effective the date of the request when reported later") kept as the base states it (Standard 30 household driver report days) and implemented by late_report_start (reported on day 28 -> effective date, from 2026-08-14); day-count clause declared overwritten.

5. Business-object card. Addition f80b0e5d (only driver addition with a premium effect); claim PD-2026-0920318 (Corolla, Tyler driving, insured_at_fault, 2,340.00 paid) vs the Pilot hail claim PD-2026-0711264 (no driver, no fault, near-miss). Counts: 3 driver adds, 2 vehicle adds, no exclusions or removals.

6. Factor card. Addition premium 346.44 (all-standard 361.10): late_report_start (method) recorded on day 28 of 30 -> from 2026-08-14 [267.58]; operator_assignment (parameter, multi-source) 3 drivers > 2 vehicles -> 60% [577.41]; at_fault_loss_load (parameter, multi-source, cross physdmg) paid at-fault loss -> 30% [266.49]; tenure_loyalty_credit (parameter) 57 months -> 5% [364.68]; continuous_coverage_share (parameter) no lapse marker -> whole credit [364.68].
Exclusion credit 74.99 (all-standard 277.48): exclusion_credit_basis (method) AP 346.44 written -> x 71/123 [101.20]; signature_start (method) -> 2026-10-05 [77.10]; rated_period_retention (parameter) 52 days -> 0.75 [99.99]; at_fault_loss_share (parameter, multi-source, cross physdmg) -> 0.5 [149.98].

7. Seed rows (27): customer, 3 drivers, 2 vehicles, policy (Standard), 8 auto transactions (4 adds at issue, two term premiums, renewal offer, Tyler's addition without AP), the exclusion form, 2 physical damage coverages, 7 claim events, 2 payments. Billing and telematics rows removed: nothing on GT's path reads them.

8. Persona. Laura, brisk; volunteers only the goal; phone and license last four when asked; Tyler's dates, the fender bender, the cars and autopay only on direct questions; passive conditional consent; signs with the four values given.

9. Standard solution: 0-1 locate/verify; 2-9 read policy, drivers, vehicles, form, ledger, physical damage coverages, claims, payments; 10-11 book Tyler's addition premium 346.44; 12-13 hand over, Laura signs (form, policy, 2026-10-05, 74.99).

10. Verification: harness gives 346.44 / 74.99, skip run 0.00. Per-task gates: EXTENDED, TASK TOOL CONTRACT, REPLAY (closure 27 = initial 27), SOLVABILITY, COMPUTE, GROUNDING, SCOPE all OK.
user_scenario:
You are Laura Ellison, 48, an office manager at a dental practice in Indianapolis, calling Cardinal Mutual on your afternoon break; you are brisk, a little rushed, and like to get things done in one call. Your son Tyler got his driver's license this summer, and after talking it over with your husband Greg you decided Tyler will not drive your cars for now. On Saturday morning, October 3, you filled out the form on the Cardinal website to exclude Tyler from the policy starting that day, but the site said your signature was still needed and you never finished it. You want Tyler's exclusion finished on this call and you want to know how much comes back to you for it. You will sign the exclusion yourself once the representative hands it to you. You are not asking for anything else today.

You open by saying you need to finish taking your son off the car insurance as an excluded driver, and you answer the rest as it comes up. When they ask for your phone number you give 3175550112; when they ask for a second detail you give the last four of your driver's license, 1768. Only if they ask for more do you give your date of birth, June 22, 1978 (1978-06-22), your ZIP code, 46220, or your email, laura.ellison@outlook.com. If they ask which policy, it is policy number CAP-IN-2287316, the only Cardinal auto policy you have. If they ask which driver, it is Tyler Ellison, your son, born February 11, 2009. If they ask about the date, you put October 3 on the form meaning as soon as possible; you just want it in effect now.

Other questions you answer only when asked, from memory. If they ask when Tyler was licensed and added, you say he got his license in the middle of August and you called it in about four weeks later, around September 11. If they ask whether Tyler has had any accidents, you admit he backed into another car in the Corolla on September 20 and the claim was paid to the body shop; you don't remember the amount. If they ask how many cars you have, it is the Corolla and the Honda Pilot. If they ask how you pay, the premium is charged to your credit card automatically every month. You don't know how Cardinal figures a credit and you won't guess at a number.

If the representative tells you something else on the policy needs handling as part of this, you say fine, go ahead. When they tell you the credit and hand you the exclusion to sign, you sign it using exactly the form reference, the policy reference, the effective date and the amount they give you, and you read back what the signing shows. Once it shows Tyler excluded, you thank them, say you'll let Tyler know, and hang up. If instead they tell you it cannot be finished today, you ask once why not, then thank them and end the call.
